hook: A neuromelanin-like selenium nanomaterial restores neuron firing and protects irradiated mice
hook_turn: restores neuron firing and protects irradiated mice
summary: Metal-selenomelanin nanonetworks normalized neuronal excitability and striatal circuit activity in mice given 6 gray whole-body radiation, improving movement and anxiety-related behavior. Treated mice also all survived 30 days and showed protection of radiosensitive organs. The study is in mice with a single dose, and human benefit and safety are unknown.
title: Neuromelanin-inspired metal-selenomelanin nanonetworks restore neuronal excitability in radiation-induced brain injury.
